<entry id="G00669">
<head-word>זֶרֶד</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="G00685">זרז</xref>) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>strength, alertness, valor</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yoma 47
<sup>a</sup> (a metaphor in imitation of Prov. XXXI, 29) כל הנשים זֶ' זָרָדוּ וזֶ' אמי עלת' לגג Ar. (read עלה; ed. הנשים זרדו וז' אימא וכ' …; Ms. M. זֶרֶז זָרָזוּ אימא, insert וזֶ'; Ms. M. 2 זריד זרדו וזֶ'; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) all women have done valiantly, but the valor of my mother excelled them all (a metaphor of careful maternity).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="G00670">next w.</xref>) pl. זְרָדִים, זְרָרִין 
<italic>shoots, greens</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Sabb. IX (X), 16; Sabb. 103
<sup>a</sup> המְזָרֵד ז' וכ' he who cuts greens, if for human food &c. Ib. XVIII, 2 (126
<sup>b</sup>) חבילי ז' bundles of greens (young reeds &c., available for fodder); ib. 128
<sup>a</sup>; Tosef. ib. XIV (XV), 10 זרדן ed. Zuck. (read זרדין, Var. דים …).—Esp. לולבי ז' 
<italic>the young sprouts of the service-tree</italic>, the interior of which is eaten as a relish. Shebi. VII, 5. Tosef. Sabb. VIII (IX), 9 לולבין וז' (corr. acc.); Tosef. Maas. Sh. I, 13; Tosef. Ukts. III, 9; Ukts. III, 4.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<pos> pr. n.</pos> (b. h.) 
<italic>Zered</italic>, name of a brook, נחלא דז'.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Num. XXI, 12; a. e.—Tosef. Shebi. IV, 11; Y. ib. VI, 36
<sup>c</sup>; Sifré Deut. 51 דורד; Yalk. Deut. 874 נחלת דור (corr. acc.); v. Hildesh. Beitr. p. 66.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="G00670">
<head-word>זָרַד</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (denom. of preced.) זָ' זֶרֶד (= עשה חיל) 
<italic>to do valiantly</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yoma 47
<sup>a</sup>, v. preced.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>זֵירֵד</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>to strengthen, accelerate growth;</italic> cmp. בְּרָא 
<italic>Af.</italic>,] 
<italic>to trim, nip shoots off</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. XII, 2 המקרסם והמְזָרֵד he who cuts off dry twigs, or young shoots. Ib. 103
<sup>a</sup>, v. preced. Ab. Zar. III, 10 (49
<sup>b</sup>). Tosef. Sabb. IX (X), 16 וזֵרֵד ed. Zuck. (Var. וזירד).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<head-word>(זַרְתָּא) זַרְדְּתָא</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (זרד) 
<italic>bushes of sorb</italic>, or 
<italic>service-tree</italic>, growing in unhealthy marshes (v. Löw. Pfl. p. 289) Pes. 111
<sup>b</sup> דבי ז' שידי (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 400) the spirits of the sorb-bushes are named 
<italic>shiddé</italic> (demons).</definition>
<notes> Ib. ז' סמיכא למתא וכ' a sorb-bush near a town has no less than sixty 
<italic>shiddé;</italic> [Ms. M. זַרְזְתָא, זִירְזְתָא, זַרְתָּא; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. notes).—Kidd. 73
<sup>b</sup> ז' … יש בו וכ' a child exposed in a sorb-bush near a town (where it is likely to die) is considered a foundling (אֲסוּפִי). Keth. 79
<sup>a</sup> אבא ז' וכ' a forest (of timber), a sorb plantation and a fish-pond.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="G00678">
<head-word>זְרֹועַ</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>arm;</italic> (with animals) 
<italic>fore-leg, shoulder; strength, force</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 17
<sup>b</sup> ניזונין בז' receive their sustenance from the Lord by dint of their strength (virtue), opp. בצדקה by divine grace. Y. Taan. IV, 69
<sup>a</sup> top זְרֹועָן של כל ישראל the arm (defence, protection) of all Israel. Sabb. 56
<sup>a</sup> נטלו בז' they took by force. Lev. R. s. 2 כבא על חבירו בז' like one coming against his neighbor with force (confident of victory).—Ḥull. X, 1 הז' the law concerning the shoulder as the priest’s share (Deut. XVIII, 3). Ib. 98
<sup>a</sup> ז' בשלה, v. בָּשֵׁל; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. זְרֹועֹות,</plural-form> constr. זְרֹועֵי. Sot. 49
<sup>b</sup>; Tosef. ib. XIV, 3 ז' תורה the supports of the Law.—בעלי ז' violent men. B. Mets. 118
<sup>a</sup>; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="G00684">
<head-word>זָרוּת</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (denom. of זָר) 
<italic>the legal status of the non-priest, the laws concerning non-priests</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ter. V, 43
<sup>c</sup> איסור ז' the prohibition as far as it concerns the T’rumah to be eaten by non-priests. Y. Bicc. II, 65
<sup>a</sup> היתר ז' inasmuch as they are permitted to non-priests. Y. Orl. II, end, 62
<sup>c</sup> משום ז' for violating the law forbidding non-priests &c.—Yeb. 68
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. (ref. to וכל זר, Lev. XXII, 10) ז' אמרתי לך וכ' the Law treats of non-priests, but not of the mourners; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="G00685">
<head-word>זָרַז</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (reduplic. of זר, v. 
<xref rid="G00737">זרר</xref>; cmp. אזר) 
<italic>to be strong, vigorous, quick</italic>, v. זָרַד.</definition>
<notes>—Part. pass. זָרוּז, v. זָרִיז.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>זֵירֵז</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to strengthen, to make active and ready, to instigate</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. 89
<sup>a</sup> כדי לזַרְזָן … קאמר he said so in order to awaken their emulation in religious acts. Nidd. 31
<sup>a</sup>; Yoma 47
<sup>a</sup> זֵירַזְתָּנִי, v. זָרָה I.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מְזֹורָז a) 
<italic>strong, vigorous</italic>. Nidd. l. c.; Snh. 70
<sup>b</sup>; a. e., v. לָבַן II.—b) 
<italic>active, zealous to do good, valiant</italic>. Macc. 23
<sup>a</sup> אין מְזָרְזִין אלא למְזֹורָזִין Ar. (ed. מזורז; some ed. מזרז, corr. acc.) only the strong-minded it is worth encouraging; Yalk. Deut. 937; Sifré Num. 1 למְזֹורָזִים; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (with ב) 
<italic>to admonish, be severe</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. Korah 6 התחיל מְזָרֵז בהן (Num. R. s. 18 לדבר להם) he began to speak to them earnestly.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִזְדָּרֵז, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִזְדָּרֵז</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be alert, zealous, conscientious</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pesik. R. s. 6 (ref. to מהיר, Prov. XXII, 29) נִזְדָּרַזְתָּ במלאכתך thou hast been zealous (conscientious) in thy own occupation. Tanḥ. P’kudé 11; a. fr.—V. זָרִיז.—3) 
<italic>to be armed</italic>. Yalk. Num. 785, v. next w.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="G00686">
<head-word>זְרַז, </head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>Pa.</italic> זָרֵיז same; </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be quick, to hurry</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. II Gen. XXIV, 20 (h. text מהר).—Targ. Ps. LXX, 2 זְרֵיז ed. (Ms. זָ'; h. text חוש); a. e.—
<italic>Part. Pe</italic>. זָרִיז, 
<italic>Pa.</italic> מְזָרֵז; pl. זְרִיזִין, זַרְזִין, מְזָרְזִין. Targ. Y. I, II Num. IX, 8, opp. מתון; v. also זָרִיז.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to quicken, strengthen</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yeb. 102
<sup>b</sup> (expl. יחליץ, Is. LVIII, 11) זָרוּזֵי גרמי it means quickening the bones. Cant. R. to II, 10 זָרֹוזִי גרמיך (not זרורזי) make thyself ready; Pesik. R. s. 15 זָרְזִי.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (cmp. זֵיר, אָזַר) 
<italic>to tie around, gird, arm; to harness, saddle</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Gen. XIV, 14. Targ. Job XXXVIII, 3 זָרֵיז Ms. (ed. זְרֵיז, זְרַז). Targ. O. Ex. XXIX, 9; a. fr.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מְזָרַז, pl. מְזַרְזִין, מְזַרְזַיָּא 
<italic>armed</italic>. Ib. XIII, 18. Targ. Is. XV, 4; a. fr.—Yeb. l. c. (ref. to וחלצה, Deut. XXV, 9) ואימא זָרוּזֵי הוא may I not say, it means 
<italic>tying on?</italic></notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִזְדָּרֵז, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִזְדְּרִיז</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to strengthen one’s self</italic> (so as not to give way to emotion).</definition>
<notes> (so as not to give way to emotion). Targ. Y. Gen. XLIII, 31. Targ. Esth. V, 10.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to gird one’s self, be armed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Num. XXXII, 17; 20; a. e.—Targ. Prov. XXX, 31, v. זַרְכֵּל.—Sifré Num. s. 157 אין החלצו אלא אִיזְדָּרְזוּ 
<italic>he</italic>
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>al’tsu</italic> (Num. XXXI, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>3)</number>
<definition />
<notes> means, be armed; Yalk. ib. 785 הִזְדָּרְזוּ (Hebr.).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

R. to I, 3 מה השמן … מְזַֹרְזֵף בשאר … מְזַרְזְפִים וכ' (not כשאר) as oil on top of another liquid, when the cup is full, does not flow over with other liquids, so will the words of the Law not flow over (the lips) in connection with words of frivolity.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="G00691">
<head-word>זַרְזִיר, </head-word>

<xref rid="G00420">זִירָה</xref>)

<italic>armed</italic>, v. זרז.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="G00692">

<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (Syr. זרזירא P. Sm. 1156,
<language-key> Ar. </language-key>
<italic>zurzur</italic>; prob. fr. זור
